patch_list: Stops Adjust and TikTok from tracking installs and in-app events, and turns off Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics and Sessions, which get every action you take in the app.
Lets songs play on the patched app. A patched app is signed with a different key, which the server rejects when it hands out the encrypted song, so without this every song would hang on "loading".

Makes "Sign in with Google" work, so your collection and playlists saved to your Google account come back. Signs in through microG RE (GmsCore) instead of Google Play services, so it needs microG RE installed and signed in to a Google acco…
Unlocks premium on your phone (no ads, every premium feature), stops the Play license check from closing the app, and keeps the ad SDK from starting so it cannot load ads or track in the background.
